official_sources.title: GDAL raster data model nodata and validity masks
official_sources.finding: Bands can expose nodata and optional nodata or transparency masks; valid-pixel statistics exclude invalid support.
official_sources.limitation: Metadata presence does not prove the marker or mask is correct.

official_sources.title: GDAL RFC 15 band mask flags and polarity
official_sources.finding: GetMaskBand yields a mask with GMF flags; zero is invalid and nonzero is valid.
official_sources.limitation: An all-valid fallback can conceal missing validity metadata.

official_sources.title: Rasterio nodata mask precedence and sidecar behavior
official_sources.finding: A dataset .msk sidecar takes precedence over nodata metadata values.
official_sources.limitation: Changing or losing the sidecar can change accepted support.

official_sources.title: GDAL warp nodata and source validity handling
official_sources.finding: Warping excludes invalid source pixels identified by nodata, masks, alpha or explicit source nodata, with kernel-dependent behavior.
official_sources.limitation: Warping creates derived samples and can change extrema.

official_sources.title: Rasterio reprojection nodata and nearest defaults
official_sources.finding: reproject exposes source/destination nodata, alpha, initialization and explicit resampling whose default is nearest.
official_sources.limitation: Nearest is still a derived destination-grid sample.

official_sources.title: GDAL fill nodata interpolation semantics
official_sources.finding: fillnodata replaces invalid regions using inverse-distance or nearest interpolation and may smooth results.
official_sources.limitation: Filled values are estimates, not original DEM observations.

official_sources.title: GDAL FillNodata algorithm controls
official_sources.finding: GDALFillNodata accepts target and mask bands, search distance, smoothing and interpolation strategy.
official_sources.limitation: Successful execution does not establish terrain truth.

official_sources.title: GDAL translation resampling and validity handling
official_sources.finding: gdal_translate can subset, resample and rescale pixels and handles source validity during resampling.
official_sources.limitation: Format conversion is not automatically sample-preserving.
